description: Long-context needle (~100k tokens, 391 KB, 3417 lines). One planted fact at ~70% depth with near-miss distractors (other room/cooler/old code). The file is far above INFER_MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT (64 KB default): a plain cat is truncated or BLOCKED and an unranged read_file returns only an outline/head/tail (or a sub-agent digest above ~320 KB), so the agent must read it in start_line/end_line chunks.
prompt: notebook.txt is a long lab notebook (one entry per line). Read through it in chunks with read_file using start_line/end_line (do not rely on grep) and find the CURRENT key code for the -80C freezer in room B214. Write only the code, in the form d-d-d-d, to answer.txt and state it in your final answer.

needles: Note: the key code for the cold room in room B214 is 5-1-9-1.

mock.final: The current key code for the -80C freezer in room B214 is 5-1-9-7.
